description: Un equipo de estudiantes universitarios apasionados por la tecnología, la ciencia y la exploración espacial. Combinamos nuestras habilidades en programación, diseño y resolución de problemas para transformar ideas innovadoras en soluciones reales
summary: For the UNIverse One project, Mission "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" we developed an interactive educational simulation of resource management and survival on the lunar South Pole, designed for junior astronaut missions over a 7-day cycle.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

The software translates real NASA data and constraints through a central command panel where the player balances resources such as energy, oxygen, water and food, facing a different emergency each day

Impact and Benefits

The project encourage STEM education by making the players go through an interactive simulation of decisions making with resources management on the Lunar South Pole

Tools and Technologies

Developed entirely in Unity with programming language C#, state machines for game logic and resource management, complemented by 3D and 2D visual assets
